name: ceo-inbox-update-folders
description: Add or remove folders/labels on a message in the principal's email. Use to star (add STARRED), label, or move messages between folders. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)

outputs.folders: string[] (updated folder/label ID list after the change)
outputs.created: string[] (labels that did not exist and were created during this call)
outputs.removed_unresolved: string[] (remove_folders tokens that matched no existing folder/label; nothing was removed for these)
outputs.read_only_skipped: string[] (SENT or DRAFT tokens in add_folders/remove_folders; Gmail sets these itself, so nothing changed for them)
